question: हमें अपने जन्मदिन (Birthday) पर क्या लगाना चाहिए? 🌱
explanation: Super star! Planting a पेड़ (Tree) on your birthday is a wonderful thing to do! 🌍
hint: It has green leaves and gives us oxygen.

question: पौधे (Plant) को बड़ा होने के लिए क्या चाहिए? 💧
explanation: Yay! Plants need पानी (Water) and sunlight to grow big and strong! 🌿
hint: It comes from the rain.

question: हम पौधा (Plant) कहाँ लगाते हैं? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! We plant a tiny sapling in the soft मिट्टी (Soil) to help it grow! 🌱
hint: It is brown and found on the ground.

question: पौधे (Plant) को बढ़ने के लिए रोशनी (Light) कौन देता है? ☀️
explanation: Great job! The warm सूरज (Sun) gives light and energy to the plants! 🌻
hint: It shines bright yellow in the day sky.

question: पेड़ (Tree) के पत्ते (Leaves) किस रंग के होते हैं? 🍃
explanation: Fantastic! Most healthy leaves are beautiful and हरे (Green)! 🌿
hint: It is the color of grass.

question: पेड़ (Tree) की डालियों पर कौन बैठता है? 🐦
explanation: Super star! Cute little पक्षी (Birds) sit and sing on tree branches! 🎶
hint: They have wings and can fly.

question: पेड़ (Tree) हमें खाने के लिए क्या देते हैं? 🍎
explanation: Yay! Trees give us sweet and yummy फल (Fruits) to eat! 🍏
hint: Apples, mangoes, and bananas are examples.

question: पौधे (Plant) पर सुंदर क्या खिलते हैं? 🌸
explanation: Brilliant! Lovely and colorful फूल (Flowers) bloom on plants! 🌼
hint: They smell very nice.

question: गर्मी (Summer) में पेड़ (Tree) हमें क्या देते हैं? 🌳
explanation: Awesome! Big trees give us cool छाँव (Shade) when it is hot outside! 🌿
hint: It is cool and dark under a tree.

question: हमें पौधों (Plants) से कैसा व्यवहार करना चाहिए? 💚
explanation: Great job! We should always give प्यार (Love) and care to our green friends! 🌍
hint: We treat them like our friends.

question: एक छोटा पौधा (Sapling) बड़ा होकर क्या बनता है? 🌲
explanation: Super star! A tiny sapling grows day by day into a huge पेड़ (Tree)! 🌲
hint: It becomes very tall and strong.

question: हम खुशी से अपना क्या मनाते हैं? 🎉
explanation: Yay! We celebrate our special जन्मदिन (Birthday) with joy and smiles! 🥳
hint: We cut a cake on this day.

question: पेड़ (Tree) मिट्टी में किससे मज़बूत रहते हैं? 🪢
explanation: Fantastic! The जड़ें (Roots) hold the tree tightly in the soil! 🌱
hint: They grow under the ground.

question: पौधा (Plant) लगाने के लिए हम मिट्टी में क्या बनाते हैं? 🕳️
explanation: Brilliant! We dig a small गड्ढा (Pit) to safely place the little plant inside! 🌍
hint: It is a small hole in the dirt.

question: पौधे (Plant) को रोज़ पानी (Water) कौन पिलाता है? 🙋
explanation: Awesome! It is a good habit that हम (We) water our plants every day! 💦
hint: You and your family do this.

question: पेड़ (Tree) के फल (Fruits) खाने में कैसे लगते हैं? 😋
explanation: Great job! Ripe fruits from a tree are so yummy and मीठे (Sweet)! 🍓
hint: They taste like honey or sugar.

question: जब हवा (Wind) चलती है, तो पेड़ के क्या हिलते हैं? 🌬️
explanation: Super star! The beautiful पत्ते (Leaves) dance when the wind blows! 🎶
hint: They are green and grow on branches.

question: पेड़ (Trees) हमारी दुनिया को कैसा बनाते हैं? 🌍
explanation: Yay! Green trees make our whole world so fresh and सुंदर (Beautiful)! 🌸
hint: They make everything look pretty.

question: आसमान से पौधों (Plants) के लिए क्या गिरता है? 🌧️
explanation: Fantastic! Plants love to drink the fresh बारिश (Rain) water from the sky! 🌧️
hint: It falls from the clouds.

question: जन्मदिन (Birthday) पर पेड़ लगाना कैसा काम है? ⭐
explanation: Brilliant! Planting a tree is a very अच्छा (Good) and helpful deed! 💚
hint: It is a positive and happy thing.

question: क्या पेड़ (Trees) हमारे दोस्त (Friends) हैं? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Trees are our best friends who give us so much! 🌳
hint: We love them very much.

question: पेड़ (Tree) हमें सांस लेने के लिए क्या देते हैं? 💨
explanation: Great job! Trees clean the हवा (Air) so we can breathe easily! 🍃
hint: We breathe this in through our nose.

question: हम नया पौधा (Plant) कहाँ रख सकते हैं? 🏡
explanation: Super star! A sunny बगीचे_में (Garden) is the best place for a plant! 🌱
hint: It is an open space outside the house.

question: पेड़ (Tree) पर अपना घोंसला (Nest) कौन बनाता है? 🪹
explanation: Yay! Little पक्षी (Birds) build cozy nests on tree branches! 🪺
hint: They sing sweet songs in the morning.

question: पौधे (Plant) के सुंदर फूलों पर कौन बैठता है? 🦋
explanation: Fantastic! A pretty तितली (Butterfly) loves to sit on blooming flowers! 🌸
hint: It has colorful wings and flies gently.

question: हम हर साल (Year) क्या मनाते हैं? 🎂
explanation: Brilliant! We joyfully celebrate our जन्मदिन (Birthday) every single year! 🎁
hint: You get older on this day.

question: क्या हम अपने प्यारे पौधे (Plant) का नाम रख सकते हैं? 🏷️
explanation: Awesome! Giving a name to your plant makes it your special friend! 💚
hint: Just like you have a name.

question: पौधा (Plant) पाकर हमें कैसा लगता है? 😊
explanation: Great job! Watching a new plant grow makes us feel so खुश (Happy)! 🌟
hint: We smile a lot.

question: क्या पेड़ (Tree) भी हमारी तरह बड़े (Grow) होते हैं? 📏
explanation: Super star! Trees grow taller and bigger just like children do! 🌳
hint: They start as small seeds.

question: गर्मी में पेड़ (Tree) की छाया कैसी होती है? 😌
explanation: Yay! Sitting under a tree gives us nice, ठंडी (Cool) shade! 🍃
hint: It feels like a gentle breeze.

question: लगाए गए पौधे (Plant) की देखभाल कौन करता है? 👨‍👩‍👧
explanation: Fantastic! It is our job and joy that हम (We) take care of our plants! 💚
hint: You and your friends do this.

question: हम जन्मदिन (Birthday) पर दोस्तों को क्या दे सकते हैं? 🎁
explanation: Brilliant! A little पौधा (Plant) is the best and most loving gift! 🎁
hint: It is green and alive.

question: पेड़ (Tree) का तना (Trunk) किसका बना होता है? 🪵
explanation: Awesome! A strong tree trunk is made of solid लकड़ी (Wood)! 🌳
hint: Tables and chairs are made from this.

question: जब हम बहुत सारे पेड़ लगाते हैं, तो धरती (Earth) कैसी होती है? 🌍
explanation: Great job! More trees make our beautiful Earth हरी (Green) and healthy! 🌍
hint: It is the color of nature.

question: क्या हमें रोज़ अपने पौधों (Plants) को देखना चाहिए? 👀
explanation: Super star! Checking on them every day shows we care and love them! 💚
hint: Good friends look after each other.

question: पेड़ (Tree) से हमें क्या मिलता है जिससे हम मेज (Table) बनाते हैं? 🪑
explanation: Yay! We use the strong लकड़ी (Wood) from trees to make furniture! 🪑
hint: It is hard and brown.

question: पेड़ (Tree) के फूल (Flowers) कैसे महकते हैं? ✨
explanation: Fantastic! Fresh flowers on a plant smell so sweet and अच्छे (Good)! 🌺
hint: They have a lovely scent.

question: पौधे (Plant) को मिट्टी (Soil) से क्या मिलता है? 🌱
explanation: Brilliant! The soil provides important nutrients, which is like खाना (Food) for the plant! 🌍
hint: We eat this when we are hungry.

question: हम पौधे में पानी (Water) किससे डालते हैं? 🚰
explanation: Awesome! We use a watering can or a जग (Jug) to gently pour water! 💦
hint: It is a container that holds liquids.

question: पेड़ (Tree) बड़े होकर हमें सुंदर क्या देते हैं? 🌼
explanation: Great job! A fully grown plant gives us beautiful, colorful फूल (Flowers)! 🌺
hint: They are soft and smell nice.

question: क्या एक पेड़ (Tree) बहुत साल तक जीवित (Live) रह सकता है? ⏳
explanation: Super star! Trees can live for many, many years and grow very big! 🌳
hint: They can be older than your grandparents.

question: हमें पौधों (Plants) को कैसे छूना चाहिए? ✋
explanation: Yay! Plants are delicate, so we must always touch them प्यार_से (Gently)! 💚
hint: With a very soft touch.

question: रसीला आम (Mango) हमें कहाँ से मिलता है? 🥭
explanation: Fantastic! Yummy mangoes grow on a big, green आम का पेड़ (Mango Tree)! 🥭
hint: It grows high up on branches.

question: क्या हम बड़े पेड़ (Tree) के गले (Hug) लग सकते हैं? 🤗
explanation: Brilliant! Hugging a big tree makes us feel close to nature! 🌳
hint: It is a nice way to show love.

question: जन्मदिन (Birthday) पर पेड़ लगाने से कौन खुश (Happy) होता है? 🥰
explanation: Awesome! Planting trees helps nature, making सब (Everyone) very happy! 💚
hint: All people, birds, and animals.

question: पौधे (Plant) लगाने से हमारे आस-पास की हवा कैसी हो जाती है? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! Trees act like magic filters and keep the air साफ (Clean)! 🍃
hint: It smells fresh and good.

question: हम अपने छोटे पौधे (Plant) के पास बैठकर क्या कर सकते हैं? 🎵
explanation: Super star! Plants love hearing a sweet गाना (Sing) from their friends! 🎶
hint: We do this with our voice on a tune.

question: पेड़ों का हरा (Green) रंग हमारी आँखों को कैसा लगता है? 👁️
explanation: Yay! The soothing green color of leaves feels very अच्छा (Good) to our eyes! 🌿
hint: It makes us feel calm.

question: क्या पेड़ (Tree) हमारी दुनिया को बचाने में मदद (Help) करते हैं? 🦸
explanation: Fantastic! Trees are nature's superheroes that always मदद (Help) us! 🌍
hint: They protect the earth.

question: क्या आप अपने अगले जन्मदिन (Birthday) पर पेड़ लगाएंगे? 🌱
explanation: Brilliant! You are an amazing friend to nature! Keep planting and smiling! 💚
hint: It is a wonderful promise.
